articles.title: Jim Cramer says Nvidia’s leadership shake-up won’t derail the AI trade
articles.summary: Cramer's comments came after another rough day for AI-related stocks in the wake of Jensen Huang's resignation from Nvidia last week. Investors have been worried that Huang's departure as CEO could jeopardize the chipmaker's financial support for the broader AI ecosystem, especially computing providers known as neoclouds. "I do not think it will cause a tsunami of selling." A successful Anthropic IPO later this week could further restore confidence in the AI trade, Cramer argued.

articles.title: Aschenbrenner’s Situational Awareness made AI bets again before October rout
articles.summary: Leopold Aschenbrenner's artificial intelligence-themed hedge fund Situational Awareness, which nearly collapsed in July, loaded back up on AI stocks as it returned to the financial markets at the end of the third quarter. articles.title: U.S. crude oil declines to $85 a barrel on recovering Middle East exports
articles.summary: Oil prices are falling Monday as shipments through the Strait of Hormuz recover and tensions between Iran and the U.S remain at a stalemate. The International Energy Agency said on Friday it expects global supply to exceed 1.7 million barrels a day in the fourth quarter of 2026, reversing its earlier forecast for a deficit as Middle East exports recover faster than global demand and even as shipping attacks continue.

articles.title: Nvidia stock falls as investors price in fallout from Jensen Huang's resignation
articles.summary: Nvidia's stock continued to slide in the wake of CEO Jensen Huang's resignation, falling around 4% on Monday after the chip giant lost hundreds of billions in market cap last week. articles.title: Bitcoin slides to $62,000 following liquidation cascade, then rebounds slightly
articles.summary: Bitcoin fell to its lowest levels since August over the weekend as a wave of forced liquidations accelerated amid broader weakening in market liquidity and risk appetite. On Friday, the dollar index — which has an inverse relationship with bitcoin — reached its highest level since April 2025, following hotter-than-expected inflation earlier this week that increased expectations of further Fed tightening.

articles.title: Robert Pattinson cast as next James Bond
articles.summary: Robert Pattinson has been cast as the next James Bond in the upcoming film from director Denis Villeneuve. It will be the 26th James Bond film and the first since Amazon MGM took over the iconic franchise. "James Bond is one of the most legendary characters in cinema, and to be entrusted with 007 is the honour of a lifetime," Pattinson said in a statement.

articles.title: Nvidia fallout: Commerce targets loophole for China's data center use
articles.summary: The Commerce Department on Monday moved to close a loophole that has let Chinese companies lease Nvidia's advanced computing power from data centers in third countries, effectively circumventing controls on sensitive chip technology being exported to China. Share prices of Nvidia and other companies linked to the artificial intelligence trade fell Monday morning after the interim rule was announced, among them chipmakers Micron Technology, Intel and Advanced Micro Devices.

articles.title: Cramer: Take some profits in these 2 stocks if you have big gains and do this with the cash
articles.summary: Stocks fell Monday as investors braced for two major tests of the artificial intelligence trade: Nvidia's earnings report Tuesday night and Anthropic's highly anticipated initial public offering later this week. Jim urged investors to trim oversized positions in Nvidia and Apple and redeploy some of those profits into more defensive stocks away from the AI trade.
